query: What is the interaction between warfarin and fluconazole, including mechanism, expected INR effect, and management implications from labelled / published evidence?

correct_answer: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9 reducing S-warfarin clearance.
INR increases; bleeding risk rises; dose-related.
Avoid or reduce warfarin with closer INR monitoring through discontinuation.

pubmed.title: Fluconazole–warfarin interaction via CYP2C9
pubmed.summary: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9 and reduces clearance of S-warfarin, increasing INR and bleeding risk. Empiric warfarin dose reduction and intensified INR monitoring are recommended around initiation and for several days after fluconazole stops.

dailymed.title: Warfarin sodium tablets — drug interactions
dailymed.summary: Azole antifungals including fluconazole may increase warfarin effect via CYP2C9 inhibition. Monitor INR closely when starting or stopping fluconazole.
